description: This PHP source file defines the CalendarSyncJobCleaner class, responsible for cleaning up or cancelling pending calendar synchronization jobs related to meetings within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for identifying relevant jobs, generating SQL conditions, and marking jobs as failed if they are superseded by newer synchronization operations.

classes.name: CalendarSyncJobCleaner
classes.description: A class responsible for cleaning up or cancelling outdated or overwritten calendar synchronization jobs, specifically for meeting-related jobs, within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: cancelPendingMeetingJobs
methods.description: Cancels pending jobs for a given calendar synchronization operation by marking them as failed if they are outdated or superseded.

methods.name: getMeetingJobCondition
methods.description: Constructs a SQL condition string to identify specific meeting jobs associated with a particular synchronization operation.

methods.name: generateMeetingJobName
methods.description: Generates a descriptive job name string based on the calendar account, location, and event identifiers for use in job filtering.

methods.name: getPendingJobStatusCondition
methods.description: Builds a SQL condition string to filter jobs in the 'queued' state that are not marked as deleted.
